item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 26/Jan/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry replenishment of the northeast monsoon will reach Guangdong tomorrow. The weather will become fine over the region. It will be cold in the morning over the coastal areas during the weekend to early next week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. A fresh to strong easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. It will be cloudier and temperatures will rise gradually over the region.

Date/Month: 27/01 (Friday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy at first. Becoming fine and dry during the day. Temperatures falling appreciably later.
Temp range: 13 - 18 C
R.H. range: 50 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
